newsitem.title: USA: McDonald's to feature Fisher-Price Happy Meal toys.
newsitem.headline: McDonald's to feature Fisher-Price Happy Meal toys.

text.p: McDonald's Corp. said Thursday it will feature Fisher-Price "Toddler Toys" in its Happy Meals for children.

McDonald's said the Toddler Toys are designed for children under age three. It said up to 24 different Fisher-Price toys will be available exclusively with Happy Meals for the next year. More designs will be available the following year.

McDonald's said the Toddler Toys include miniature versions of Fisher-Price's crib, playpen and preschool lines including the Chatter Telephone, a rotary phone on wheels, and the Bead Ball, a ball with colourful beads that slide and rattle.
McDonald's said all its Happy Meal give-away toys are safety-tested for children of all ages.
McDonald's has more than 19,200 restaurants in 94 countries. Fisher-Price is a unit of Mattel Inc.
McDonalds stock was down 12.5 cents at $47.50 and Mattel was up 12.5 cents at $27.50, both on the New York Stock Exchange.
